verdict.rationale: The evidence shows a public GitHub repository at github.com/jdx/mise whose contents users can browse; community members describe reading the repo's workflow files. Nothing in the pack names the license, so the 'open license' half of the story is unproven. missing for 10: explicit license identification (e.g., an OSI-approved license file), first-party documentation that the source is openly licensed, independent corroboration of license terms.
